blind.description: A gothic, spider-themed floor candelabra. It features a circular black base decorated with an orange spiderweb relief pattern, a central vertical post with dripping tan wax running down its side, and a top capital shaped as a stylized black spider. The spider's eight curved legs cradle a cluster of four thick beige pillar candles with dark unlit wicks. The spider's head features green eyes and a green dorsal stripe.
blind.from_above: Four round beige candle tops with central wicks arranged in a 2x2 cluster, surrounded radially by eight curved black spider legs, with the spider's green-accented head at the front edge and the circular web-patterned base showing below.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 feet tall (roughly 60% the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 feet in diameter at the base.
